title: The 5 Most Viewed YouTube Videos Ever, Ranked (Despacito Is Only #3)

scenes.text: The five most watched YouTube videos ever, ranked. Despacito isn't number one. It isn't even number two.

scenes.label: Johny Johny · 7.2 billion
scenes.text: Number five: Johny Johny Yes Papa, by LooLoo Kids. About 7.2 billion views. A nursery rhyme.

scenes.label: Bath Song · 7.5 billion
scenes.text: Number four: Bath Song, by Cocomelon. About 7.5 billion views. Another nursery rhyme.

scenes.label: Despacito · 9.1 billion
scenes.text: Number three: Despacito, Luis Fonsi and Daddy Yankee. Around 9.1 billion views, the most watched music video ever.

scenes.label: Wheels on the Bus · 9.3 billion
scenes.text: Number two: Wheels on the Bus, by Cocomelon. Around 9.3 billion. It overtook Despacito in 2026.

scenes.label: Baby Shark · 17 billion
scenes.text: Number one: Baby Shark Dance, by Pinkfong. About 17 billion views, the first video ever past 10 billion. That's twice for every person on Earth.

description:
The five most viewed YouTube videos of all time, ranked by total views as of autumn 2026.
Johny Johny Yes Papa (about 7.2 billion), Bath Song (about 7.5 billion), Despacito (around 9.1 billion, the most watched music video ever), Wheels on the Bus (around 9.3 billion, which passed Despacito in 2026) and, far ahead, Baby Shark Dance with about 17 billion views, the first video ever to pass 10 billion. Four of the five are children's songs.
Which video did you expect to see on this list?
first_comment: Baby Shark was uploaded in June 2016 and took the top spot from Despacito in November 2020. Who would you have put at number one, and what should we rank next?
